summary: Iteration 9 — Full validation of the new USD/TRY exchange rate settings feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 10/10 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_usd_rate.py covering admin GET, POST refresh, PUT manual/auto/validation, public endpoint auth, and unaffected /admin/notifications/config. Live rate observed = 47.172159 TRY/USD from open.er-api (Frankfurter did not respond during tests but fallback works as designed). Auto-fetch background loop confirmed via backend logs ('[usd_rate] Auto-fetched 47.172159 from open.er-api'). Frontend: All required data-testid selectors present and functional — usd-rate-widget shows '47.17' in topbar next to theme toggle, sidebar 'Ayarlar' (nav-admin-settings) leads to /admin/ayarlar, no legacy 'nav-admin-bot' exists, both settings-tab-usd/bot render, all 4 USD controls (us-auto-toggle, us-refresh, us-manual-input, us-manual-save) present, Telegram tab renders AdminBot content (ab-token/ab-save), USD controls unmount when Bot tab is active, legacy /admin/bot redirects to /admin/ayarlar?tab=bot. Final state left with mode='auto' as requested.

verifications_passed.backend_pytest_10_of_10: PASS — /app/test_reports/pytest/iter9_usd_rate.xml. TestGetAdminUsdRate (returns all 6 fields, rate in realistic 10-200 range, unauth 401); TestRefreshUsdRate (force refresh returns 47.172159 from open.er-api); TestPutUsdRate (manual 55.5 → mode=manual+source=manual, switch to auto → mode=auto+source=open.er-api and fresh live rate, usd_rate=0 → 400, {} → 400 'Değişiklik yok'); TestPublicUsdRate (admin token 200 with 3 fields, no auth → 401); TestExistingEndpointsUnaffected (/api/admin/notifications/config 200).
verifications_passed.auto_fetch_background_loop: PASS — /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log contains 'INFO:root:[usd_rate] Auto-fetched 47.172159 from open.er-api' twice (initial fetch after startup sleep(10) + when mode-switch triggered force refresh). Loop registered via app.state.usd_rate_task at startup.
verifications_passed.live_rate_source_fallback: PASS — Live rate 47.172159 fetched from open.er-api (Frankfurter primary silently failed and fallback took over as designed). Rate persisted with usd_rate_source='open.er-api'.
verifications_passed.frontend_usd_widget_topbar: PASS — [data-testid='usd-rate-widget'] visible in top-right topbar directly right of theme toggle button, showing '$ 47.17 ₺' with [data-testid='usd-rate-value']='47.17' matching backend usd_rate rounded to 2dp.
verifications_passed.frontend_sidebar_ayarlar_nav: PASS — [data-testid='nav-admin-settings'] label='Ayarlar', points to /admin/ayarlar, clicking loads [data-testid='admin-settings-page']. Old [data-testid='nav-admin-bot'] does NOT exist in DOM.
verifications_passed.frontend_settings_tabs_and_controls: PASS — [settings-tab-usd] and [settings-tab-bot] both visible. USD tab exposes us-auto-toggle, us-refresh, us-manual-input, us-manual-save (all visible). Clicking us-refresh triggers backend POST and widget continues to reflect current rate.
verifications_passed.frontend_bot_tab_renders_adminbot: PASS — Clicking [settings-tab-bot] renders AdminBot component including [data-testid='ab-token'] and [data-testid='ab-save']. When Bot tab is active, [data-testid='us-auto-toggle'] is not in DOM (Radix Tabs unmounts inactive content — expected behavior).
verifications_passed.frontend_legacy_bot_route_redirect: PASS — Navigating to /admin/bot redirects to /admin/ayarlar?tab=bot and renders AdminBot content (ab-token visible). Implemented via <Route path='/admin/bot' element={<Navigate to='/admin/ayarlar?tab=bot' replace/>}/>.
verifications_passed.final_state_mode_auto: PASS — Ended tests with GET /admin/settings/usd-rate → {usd_rate:47.172159, mode:'auto', source:'open.er-api'}. Preserves default state as requested.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1798 — GET /settings/usd-rate/public depends on get_current_user which returns 401/403 on missing/invalid token; any authenticated user (admin OR site user) can access. Matches spec.

server.py:1782-1783 — Auto-switch triggers force refresh only when mode='auto' AND usd_rate is None. Correct: prevents overwriting an explicit manual value while still allowing mode toggle. Verified via test_switch_back_to_auto_triggers_fresh_fetch.

server.py:1437-1451 — _usd_rate_fetch_loop sleeps 3600s between refreshes with proper CancelledError handling on both sleeps. Good defensive coding. Consider making the interval configurable via env for future flexibility (non-blocking).

server.py:1379-1395 — _fetch_live_usd_rate iterates USD_RATE_SOURCES list; Frankfurter primary silently failing during tests confirms fallback works. Consider adding a 5xx-status vs network-error distinction in logging for better observability (non-blocking).

AdminSettings.jsx uses Radix Tabs which unmounts inactive TabsContent — this means USD tab controls are absent while Bot tab is open. This is correct behavior but note: if user is mid-edit in manual-input and clicks Bot tab, unsaved input is lost. Consider warning or persisting local state (non-blocking, minor UX).
Layout.jsx:287-295 — usd-rate-widget uses font-data (tabular) which prevents layout jitter as rate changes. Good.

Positive observations: (a) clean separation of concerns — AdminSettings.jsx pure container, AdminSettingsUsdRate.jsx handles USD logic, AdminBot.jsx reused unchanged; (b) URL param ?tab=bot preserves deep-linkability; (c) legacy redirect is idiomatic <Navigate replace> that preserves browser back-button semantics; (d) all Mongo _id excluded via projection {'_id': 0}.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests mutate only the admin_settings singleton (id='global') and restore mode='auto' via autouse fixture teardown. Final state confirmed via curl.

Backend endpoints: GET/PUT /api/admin/settings/usd-rate, POST /api/admin/settings/usd-rate/refresh, GET /api/settings/usd-rate/public. Background loop refreshes hourly (see [usd_rate] log lines).
